title: The Long Chase
description: The hunting calendar of a valley that takes its sport seriously:
a muster, a bow, four quarries, and two trophies for a wall that
will only ever hold one of them, because the wall belongs to a
house that settles arguments by not buying a second hook.
This group is where the collection keeps its hunting vocabulary:
a kill task that names its quarry, one that filters by the mob's
own data for what an id cannot pick out, one that counts a whole
tag of them, a biome named exactly rather than by tag, a vanilla
statistic, and the second exclusive group -- two trophies, one
